title: One more step towards better stability of non-fullerene organic solar cells: advances, challenges, future perspectives, and the Era of artificial intelligence
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5093-5158
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06021K, Review Article
Nafees Ahmad, Jun Yuan, Yingping Zou
This review summarizes the recent progress, challenges, and future perspective towards stable non-fullerene organic solar cells (NF-OSCs) with detailed discussion of various aspects and effective strategies to improve the stability of NF-OSCs.
